title: Modern 3BR Home in South Congress
description: Bright modern 3-bedroom home in the heart of South Congress. Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants and a highly rated elementary school. Open floor plan, large windows, landscaped backyard, attached garage.

title: Charming 2BR Bungalow near Zilker
description: Classic Austin bungalow two blocks from Zilker Park. Original hardwood floors, updated kitchen, shaded front porch. Quiet street, very walkable neighborhood, zoned to good schools.

title: Downtown Luxury Condo with Skyline Views
description: Sleek 2-bed 2-bath condo on the 21st floor with floor-to-ceiling windows and downtown skyline views. Full-service building: concierge, rooftop pool, fitness center. Steps from restaurants and nightlife.

title: Family Home in Eanes ISD, Westlake
description: Spacious 4-bedroom family home in the award-winning Eanes ISD. Large kitchen with island, game room, covered patio, big backyard. Cul-de-sac street, strong community feel.

title: New-Construction Townhome, East Austin
description: Brand-new 2-story townhome with rooftop deck and east-side energy. Quartz counters, smart home package, energy-efficient build. Minutes to downtown, food trucks and live music venues.

title: Starter Condo near UT Campus
description: Efficient 1-bed condo ideal for first-time buyers or investors. Updated bath, in-unit laundry, secure parking. Walkable to UT campus, local bakeries and bus lines.

title: Spacious 4BR in Cedar Park, Top Schools
description: Well-kept 4-bedroom home in a family-oriented Cedar Park neighborhood. Community pool, playground, top-rated schools nearby. Open kitchen, large master suite, three-car garage.

title: Renovated Mid-Century House, Mueller
description: Thoughtfully renovated mid-century home in Mueller. Chef's kitchen, new systems, owned solar panels. Walk to farmers market, lake trail and Mueller's parks. Great for young families.

title: Waterfront Townhome, Lake Travis
description: Three-story townhome with Lake Travis views and private boat slip access. Open-concept living, covered balconies on every floor, community pool. Marina and restaurants within walking distance.

title: Quiet 2BR House, Round Rock
description: Move-in ready 2-bedroom home on a quiet cul-de-sac in Forest Creek. Fenced backyard with mature trees, new HVAC, golf community. Affordable entry with strong resale area.

title: Modern Loft Condo, Rainey Street
description: Industrial-chic loft on Rainey Street. Exposed concrete, oversized windows, built-in storage. Walkable to the best food scene downtown, in-unit washer, secured building.

title: Hill Country Estate Home, Bee Cave
description: Elegant 5-bedroom estate on a cul-de-sac in Bee Cave. Hill Country views, resort-style pool, media room, three-car garage. Top-rated Lake Travis schools, minutes to the Galleria.

title: Cozy Townhome near Domain
description: Low-maintenance townhome minutes from the Domain. Private patio, open-plan living, attached garage. Pet-friendly community, walk to breweries and shops.

title: Historic 3BR near Downtown Pflugerville
description: Solid 3-bedroom home with new roof and updated kitchen. Big fenced yard, mature shade trees, no HOA. Easy commute to Austin tech employers, family-friendly streets.

title: Garden Condo with Private Entrance, SoFi
description: Garden-level condo with private entrance and courtyard views. Quiet boutique building of 12 units. Walk to South First coffee shops and food trucks. Tandem parking included.

title: Single-Story 4BR, Steiner Ranch
description: Single-story home in Steiner Ranch with canyon views. Community pools and tennis, zoned to top schools. Open living, covered deck, oversized primary suite.

title: New Build 3BR, Hutto
description: Never-lived-in 3-bedroom new build. Energy-efficient package, smart thermostat, covered patio. Builder warranty, growing family community, quick move-in available.

title: Bungalow-Style Condo near LBJ
description: Well-priced 2-bed condo in Cherrywood. Updated kitchen with shaker cabinets, hardwood-style floors, mature landscaping. Close to hospitals and UT shuttle line.

title: Executive 4BR Home, Avery Ranch
description: Executive home backing to the Avery Ranch golf course. Dedicated home office, media room, covered outdoor kitchen. Family-friendly cul-de-sac, A-rated schools.

title: Urban 2BR Condo with Balcony, Domain
description: Stylish condo overlooking the Domain. Private balcony, quartz counters, resort-style pool and 24/7 gym. Walk to Apple campus, shops, restaurants — zero commute lifestyle.
